sentences.Hvem skal bake, og hvem vil smake?: Who will bake, and who wants a taste?
sentences.En katt, ei mus og ei høne bor sammen. E: A cat, a mouse and a hen live together. One day the hen says:
sentences.– Vi har ikke mat i huset. Nå må vi bake: – We have no food in the house. Now we must bake.
– Yes, we must, says the cat.
– Yes, we must, says the mouse.
– Who will go and get flour? asks the hen.
– Then I must go, says the hen.
The hen comes back with flour.
– Who will bake the cake? asks the hen.
sentences.– Da må jeg gjøre det, sier høna, og så: – Then I must do it, says the hen, and so she makes a cake and bakes it.
The cake is ready and is lying on the table.
– Who wants to eat the cake? asks the hen.
sentences.– Nei, det vil jeg, det, sier høna, og s: – No, I do, says the hen, and then she eats up the whole cake.
